question: May graphrefly-py:D797-KERNEL-PY be implemented in the Python package?
decision: Authorize implementing graphrefly-py:D797-KERNEL-PY in this repository, one phase at a time in its listed order, within its acceptance and non_goals. Each phase, beginning with the transition step, starts only on the user's explicit word; the checkpoint phase starts only after the user has admitted the checkpoint module. Where a rule is unclear or conflicts with an existing Python decision, work stops and the user is asked. No provider, live, network or spend action is authorized.
rationale: The user approved execution of the admitted slice on 2026-11-10 and asked that the record be written here; the work gate requires an execution-approval ref for in-progress implementation.

layer: L1-L6 / Python D797 kernel execution approval: continuous phases and branch pushes
question: How do the phases of graphrefly-py:D797-KERNEL-PY start, get committed and get pushed, now that the user will review the finished changes in a separate chat?
decision: Replace the clauses of graphrefly-py:D1 under which each phase starts only on the user's word, is shown to the user before it is committed, is committed only on the user's word, and nothing is pushed. From now on the phases run in their listed order without waiting for the user; when a phase's checks pass (the package suite, ruff, mypy, that phase's scenarios and the reference benchmark), it is committed and pushed to the branch d797-kernel-migration, the first push with git push -u origin d797-kernel-migration. Nothing is pushed to main, no pull request is opened and nothing is merged. Public API decisions are still written as graphrefly-py decisions, without waiting for the user to see them first. A short report of each phase (scenarios passed, checks, commit) goes to the cross-runtime alignment session, and a summary when the slice stops (every commit, the new local decisions, the deleted tests, every departure from the plan). Work still stops and goes to that session when the checkpoint phase would start before the root has admitted the checkpoint module (the cut-over follows the checkpoint phase, so it stops after phase 5 then), at phase 6 while it is deferred, when a check fails and cannot be fixed, when a rule is unclear or a cross-runtime API shape needs aligning, and when another repository would have to change. The other clauses of graphrefly-py:D1 stand.
rationale: The user, relayed by the cross-runtime alignment session on 2026-11-10: "让他们自动提交和推送。等做完我就用新的chat去审核这些changes", and, asked where to push after this session found that a push to main runs release-please and the docs deployment, "推到 d797 分支"; the user confirmed it in this session the same day ("是，照做"). The three runtimes share the branch name d797-kernel-migration.

completion.complete_when: Every phase of graphrefly-py:D797-KERNEL-PY up to where the slice stops is committed and pushed to d797-kernel-migration with its evidence, or the user stops the slice.
completion.historical_when: The slice completes, is superseded or is cancelled, or the user changes how its phases are approved.
